title: Dhanyawad kare, Prabhu ki mahima kare

lines.text: Dhanyawad kare, Prabhu ki mahima kare,
Kyonki uski karuna sada ki hai !
Jeevan mein bahutayat usi ne di hain
Kyonki uski karuna sada ki hai
Kyonki jeevan mein aman diya hai
Jeevan mein vishwas usine diya hai
Kyonki uski karuna sada ki hai

chords:
[CHORUS]
Dhanyawad kare, Prabhu ki mahima kare,
Aur kare stuti aaradhna
Kyonki uski karuna sada ki hai !

[Verse 1]
Dhanyawad kare, prabhu ka
Kyonki jeevan usine diya hai
Dhanyawad kare, prabhu ka
Jeevan mein bahutayat usi ne di hain
To chalo aao sabhi
Hath uthakar sabhi
Bolo Yeshu Masih ki jay
Kyonki uski karuna sada ki hai

[Verse 2]
Dhanyawad kare, prabhu ka
Kyonki jeevan mein aman diya hai
Dhanyawad kare, prabhu ka
Jeevan mein vishwas usine diya hai
To chalo aao sabhi
Hath uthakar sabhi
Bolo Yeshu Masih ki jay
Kyonki uski karuna sada ki hai
